title: Mapo tofu with lean pork mince
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet; dice the tofu, leave it in hot salted water for 2 minutes and drain.
Fry the mince in the oil until crumbly, add the garlic, ginger and chilli flakes for 1 minute.
Add the miso, soy sauce and stock, gently add the tofu and simmer for 5 minutes.
Thicken with the cornflour mixed with water; steam the pak choi briefly alongside.
Sprinkle with spring onions and serve with rice and pak choi.
